title: A word association network methodology for evaluating implicit biases in LLMs compared to humans

bias_targets.methodology: Stereotypes approach measuring differences in final activation levels between gender-related prime nodes and stereotypical trait target nodes within word association networks.
Valence approach analyzing how religion-related prime nodes activate network nodes with varying positive and negative valence ratings to measure general positive or negative perceptions.
Valence approach analyzing how ethnicity-related prime nodes activate network nodes with varying positive and negative valence ratings to measure general positive or negative perceptions.
Valence approach analyzing how sexual orientation-related prime nodes activate network nodes with varying positive and negative valence ratings to measure general positive or negative perceptions.
Emotions approach quantifying differences in the final activation levels of emotion-related target nodes (representing eight core emotions) after being activated by political party prime nodes.
